kids: Watch a Christmas movie under the stars
about: Wakulla County posts Christmas in the Park on its own county website as the most wonderful night in Wakulla, hosted by the sheriff's office with county administration.
The county describes it as a free family holiday celebration, with lights and community fun planned for the park.
Food is complimentary: hot dogs, popcorn and drinks are all listed as free.
Santa is on hand to give presents to children, a detail the county names directly in its announcement.
Entertainment for kids includes a bounce house and a Christmas movie shown under the stars.
Holiday vendors set up with treats, crafts and more, and the county runs a vendor registration form for local sellers.
The county advises bringing chairs, blankets and holiday spirit, since the movie and lights are outdoors at Hudson Park.
